style.prompt: Original fantasy creature character render for a premium creature-collecting game. Stylised but physically convincing 3D character, painterly cinematic finish. Three-quarter view facing slightly left, camera at the creature's eye level. Soft key light from upper left, cool rim light from behind right, soft ambient fill, subtle subsurface scattering on organic skin. Rich, species-appropriate surface detail with natural colour variation and fine imperfections. Elemental light effects are restrained and integrated into the anatomy. Full body in frame, centred, creature occupies about 80% of the frame height with even margin. Isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground, no scenery, no cast shadow, no text, no frame.
style.negative: no text, no watermark, no logo, no border, no background scenery, no ground plane, no cropping of limbs or tail, not a cartoon mascot, not low-poly, not pixel art, not anime, no extra heads, no duplicated limbs, no generic dragon unless specified

mossling.silhouette: Low, broad, rounded quadruped with a domed back and branching antlers rising above the head.

mossling.effects: Tiny floating green spores and faint bioluminescent veins in the leaves.
